skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply economic principles to agricultural production, services, and policy.
Analyze and evaluate economic policies related to agriculture and rural development.
Apply microeconomic concepts to agricultural markets and services.
Understand macroeconomic impacts on agricultural sectors and rural economies.
Manage agricultural production and services effectively.
Develop critical thinking skills to solve agricultural economic problems.
Communicate effectively in agricultural economics contexts.
Conduct research on agricultural economics topics.
Solve problems related to agricultural economics and rural development.
Develop self-learning skills to enhance agricultural economics knowledge.
